NonPrimaryEventName.title: NonPrimaryEventName
NonPrimaryEventName.description: Used to define the type of event (eg. Key, GPI, Tone, Audio or Video Effects) (See Configuration Section in BXF Protocol Documentation)

OptionalFlag.title: OptionalFlag
OptionalFlag.description: Optional event, will not air unless triggered

PrimaryEventId.title: PrimaryEventId
PrimaryEventId.description: Linkage to the primary event id.  Not required for auxillary events.  Required to be a UUID.

NonPrimaryElementId.title: NonPrimaryElementId
NonPrimaryElementId.description: A UUID that is used to link to the format structure's non-primary element definition

OffsetTime.title: OffsetTime
OffsetTime.description: The amount of time to offset the nonprimary event from the start or end of a primary event based on the values of the attribute settings.

Offset.description: The definition of how a non-primary event should run relative to the primary event either using the start or end points of either event.

AudioOverPercent.title: AudioOverPercent
AudioOverPercent.description: Used to set an adjustment to the audio levels for voice over audio

GraphicData.description: Use to add in graphics associated data  to a specific secondary event. Used for delineating a graphic collection, keyer number, template name, etc.

OverlayPlacement.description: Describes locations in time and space where overlays are either permitted or restricted from use.

NonProgramEvents.title: NonProgramEvents
NonProgramEvents.description: Used to specify non-primary events that use speciific interstitial content

ProgramEvent.title: ProgramEvent
ProgramEvent.description: Used to specify non-primary events that use specific program content

GraphicCollectionName.title: GraphicCollectionName
GraphicCollectionName.description: The collection in which the template can be found

GraphicTemplate.title: GraphicTemplate
GraphicTemplate.description: Name of template used for graphics overlay

GraphicKeyer.title: GraphicKeyer
GraphicKeyer.description: Name or number of the keyer being used

GraphicKeyValuePairs.description: Pair of Key values associated with Graphic details (v6.0)

GraphicData.description: Use to add in graphics associated data  to a specific secondary event. Used for delineating a graphic collection, keyer number, template name, etc.
